mapper.sql: a.achievement_id, a.management_no, a.teacher_user_id, COALESCE((SELECT k.name FROM korus_personnel_snapshots k WHERE k.employee_no = u.employee_no), u.login_id) AS teacher_name, a.organization_code, a.evaluation_year, a.management_item_code, a.achievement_date, d.performance_detail, a.achievement_status, a.attachment_ids, a.created_at, a.updated_at
FROM education_achievements a JOIN course_operation_achievement_details d ON d.achievement_id = a.achievement_id JOIN users u ON u.user_id = a.teacher_user_id
mapper.select: SELECT m.organization_code FROM organization_user_mappings m WHERE m.user_id = #{userId} AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY m.organization_code LIMIT 1
mapper.sql: FROM evaluation_management_items m JOIN evaluation_elements e ON e.element_id = m.element_id JOIN evaluation_items i ON i.item_id = e.item_id JOIN evaluation_areas a ON a.area_id = i.area_id JOIN evaluation_element_management_item_settings s ON s.rule_version_id = a.rule_version_id AND s.element_code = e.element_code AND s.management_item_code = m.management_item_code AND s.evaluation_year = e.evaluation_year AND s.area_code = a.area_code AND s.item_code = i.item_code WHERE m.active_yn = 'Y' AND e.active_yn = 'Y' AND i.active_yn = 'Y' AND a.active_yn = 'Y' AND s.active_yn = 'Y' AND s.teacher_editable_yn = 'Y' AND m.teacher_editable_yn = 'Y' AND a.area_code = 'EDUCATION' AND e.evaluation_year = #{year} AND CURRENT_DATE BETWEEN s.effective_start_date AND s.effective_end_date AND (s.target_scope = 'ALL' OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM organization_user_mappings t WHERE t.user_id = #{userId} AND t.status = 'ACTIVE' AND t.organization_code = s.target_scope ))
mapper.select:
SELECT m.management_item_code
GROUP BY m.management_item_code HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m.element_id) = 1 ORDER BY m.management_item_code
mapper.update: UPDATE education_achievements SET management_item_code = #{code}, achievement_date = #{date}, attachment_ids = CAST(#{attachments} AS jsonb), updated_by = #{actorId}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, request_id = #{requestId} WHERE achievement_id = #{id} AND achievement_type = 'course-operations' AND deleted_yn = 'N' AND achievement_status IN ('DRAFT', 'DEPARTMENT_REJECTED', 'CERTIFICATION_REJECTED')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO education_achievement_status_histories ( achievement_type, achievement_id, next_status, action_type, processed_by, opinion, request_id ) VALUES ('course-operations', #{id}, 'DRAFT', 'CREATE', #{actorId}, '강좌 개설·운영 최초 입력', #{requestId})
